claim_boundary: Conditional on a critical fixed-beta Cycle-63 census through Cycle 165, this forces one massed labelled terminal web. It does not bound the census or a web, prove E7/E9, density, or intervals.

massed_web_output.statement: A rank-one or plane-induced shift state has X^(1/25-o(1)) parents, or a beta-seeded packet state has X^(2/25-o(1)) parents.

prior_context.cycle165_role: provides the labelled rank-one/high-packet/low-plane terminal partition at X^(38/25-o(1))

remaining_target.statement: Control one massed web, or turn a seeded packet/shift web into a strict E7/E9 skeleton margin while retaining beta, divisibility, and h-range labels.

terminal_entropy_inverse.boundary: This conditional inverse forces one massed labelled web. It does not bound the original census, control the web, prove E7/E9, density, or intervals.
terminal_entropy_inverse.near_shift: the bounded exponential range forces B=r-s+t=0 in the near branch; reduction gives a labelled rational shift packet
terminal_entropy_inverse.packet_state: canonical maximal depth is determined by (ell,a/q), so it adds no entropy coordinate
terminal_entropy_inverse.plane_shift: R=D+N and S=D+N' obey |S-E_u R|=O(H/X), so fixed (u,R) has at most one S
terminal_entropy_inverse.transverse: with no high projection fibre, each (u,r,s,t) has at most one ell and then t is unique
